name: Staged MCP Plugin Activation
summary: Advance an MCP-backed plugin through exact-package checks, endpoint verification, semantic discovery repairs, real review tests and bounded public-connection acceptance.
problem: Package validation, endpoint discovery and a public skills listing can be mistaken for a fully tested, reviewed and connected tool integration.
coreOutcomes: Narrow annotation repairs with compatibility evidence
Separate written scenarios from executed review cases
Truthful public-owner and clean-account acceptance states
requirements: Existing plugin and candidate package or draft
Current provider submission and connection documentation
Authorised deployment and provider review surfaces
Repository-native contract checks and applicable review gates
Supported test client and non-sensitive representative inputs
boundaries: Does not bypass publication, consent or repository review gates
Provider ownership and discovery do not prove all clients or tools work
An edited privacy policy does not prove scanner clearance
An owner test does not establish independent customer adoption
Provider-specific submission rules must be refreshed
